question_decisions.note: The provisions and the rule statement hold up, but the answer's primary application reads the facts against the question's own words ("Anuk's divided block of land"), and the indispensable rule (16)(b) is held in the corpus only in its post-2022 form, without the proviso in force in April 2020.

disagreements.researcher_position: On the stated facts the brothers still hold undivided one third shares of the 45 perch portion, so the Schedule must describe the whole portion and the deed convey an undivided one third; the divided block description is the alternative.
disagreements.verifier_position: Part (iii) as set describes the subject as "Anuk's divided block of land", so the description the question asks for is more likely the divided block defined by its own particular boundaries and extent under rule (16)(b) and s.13(2), with the undivided share as the alternative. The order of the two limbs in the gold answer may be inverted.

disagreements.researcher_position: No amendment event touches paragraph (b) of rule (16), so the corpus text is the April 2020 text.
disagreements.verifier_position: Act No. 31 of 2022, s.16(9)(b) substituted the words from "which it is a share: Provided, however" to the end of paragraph (b), so the April 2020 paragraph contained a proviso the corpus does not reproduce and whose effect on a post-partition description is unknown.

unsupported_claims: CL-M077-Q01-003 marked disputed: the rule it states is verbatim in the corpus, but the corpus holds only the post-2022 form of rule (16)(b), so the statement may be incomplete for April 2020.

CL-M077-Q01-009 marked disputed: the finding that Anuk can convey only an undivided one third is an inference from the background that conflicts with the question's description of "Anuk's divided block of land".

Registration of Documents Ordinance s.13(5) is the Act No. 50 of 1982 text, not untouched 1927 text (PROV-M077-004); this does not change the April 2020 position.
Act No. 21 of 2013, s.2 amends s.13(6) only (registration fee) and does not bear on the description requirement.
The corpus text of the 2011 substituted paragraph in 47-2011/s2 is truncated at "section 2 of the Pradeshiya Sabha number" (PROV-M077-006).

The municipality, town and development area limb of rule (16)(a) was missing from the quoted excerpts and has been added as PROV-M077-901.
The proviso formerly closing rule (16)(b) is an exception that cannot be read from the corpus.
